chip_specification.project_title: Nanophotonic Adipose Photolipolysis Metasurface Beam Homogenizer Chip
chip_specification.clinical_application: Non-Invasive Hyperthermic Laser Lipolysis & Selective Subcutaneous Photothermolysis
chip_specification.polarization: TE (Dual TE/TM Polarization Insensitive at Normal Incidence)

synthesized_nanostructure.fill_fraction_definition: Linear duty cycle: 56.36% (w/Lambda); 2D pillar area fraction: 31.77% (w^2/Lambda^2)
